instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om investorbeskyttelse, BEK nr 760 af 14/06/2024
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 760 af 14/06/2024, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the Minister for Business (Morten Bødskov), § 20 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om investorbeskyttelse ved værdipapirhandel
titles.en: Executive Order on investor protection in securities trading

payload.implementsNote: Parts of MiFID II, Directive 2014/65/EU, as amended by Directives (EU) 2016/1034 and (EU) 2021/338, and parts of BRRD II, Directive (EU) 2019/879

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act honestly, fairly and professionally in the clients' best interests
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 760 af 14/06/2024 (investorbeskyttelse ved værdipapirhandel), § 3

titles.en: Act honestly, fairly and professionally in the clients' best interests

summaries.en: A bank or other firm providing investment services must act honestly, fairly and professionally and in the best interests of its clients in all its securities business.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell a per se professional client how it will be treated and that it can ask for more protection
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 760 af 14/06/2024 (investorbeskyttelse ved værdipapirhandel), § 4, stk. 2-3

titles.en: Tell a per se professional client how it will be treated and that it can ask for more protection

summaries.en: Before providing services to a client that counts as professional under section a of Annex 1, the firm must tell the client that it will be treated as a professional client unless agreed otherwise, and that it may ask for different terms that give it a higher level of protection.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep marketing communications clear, not misleading and identifiable as marketing
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 760 af 14/06/2024 (investorbeskyttelse ved værdipapirhandel), § 5

titles.en: Keep marketing communications clear, not misleading and identifiable as marketing

summaries.en: Marketing and other commercial communication to clients or potential clients about a product or service must be clear and must not be misleading, and marketing material must be clearly recognisable as such.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the client before advising whether the advice is independent and how broad it is
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 760 af 14/06/2024 (investorbeskyttelse ved værdipapirhandel), § 6, stk. 2

titles.en: Tell the client before advising whether the advice is independent and how broad it is

summaries.en: In good time before giving investment advice, the firm must tell the client whether the advice is given on an independent basis, whether it rests on a broad or a more restricted analysis of financial instruments (including whether the range is limited to instruments from closely linked entities), and whether the firm will periodically assess the suitability of the recommended instruments.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Explain the instruments and strategies offered, with risk warnings and target market
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 760 af 14/06/2024 (investorbeskyttelse ved værdipapirhandel), § 6, stk. 3-4

titles.en: Explain the instruments and strategies offered, with risk warnings and target market

summaries.en: In good time before an agreement is made, the firm must describe the financial instruments and investment strategies it offers, give relevant guidance and warnings on their risks, and say whether an instrument is aimed at retail or professional clients. The information must be understandable, may be standardised and is given electronically, with retail clients told they can have it on paper.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Inform clients in good time of all costs and charges
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 760 af 14/06/2024 (investorbeskyttelse ved værdipapirhandel), § 8

titles.en: Inform clients in good time of all costs and charges

summaries.en: The firm must give the client, in good time, information on all costs and related charges of the investment service and any ancillary services and of the instruments recommended or marketed, and on how they are to be paid, including costs paid indirectly through a third party.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess suitability before advising or managing a portfolio
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 760 af 14/06/2024 (investorbeskyttelse ved værdipapirhandel), § 9

titles.en: Assess suitability before advising or managing a portfolio

summaries.en: When giving investment advice or managing a portfolio, the firm must obtain the information it needs on the client's knowledge and experience, financial situation including ability to bear losses, and investment objectives including risk tolerance, and recommend only services and instruments that suit the client. Where the service involves switching instruments for a retail client, the firm analyses the costs and benefits of the switch and, when advising, tells the client whether the benefits outweigh the costs; a recommended package must be suitable as a whole.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give a retail client a suitability statement before an advised transaction
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 760 af 14/06/2024 (investorbeskyttelse ved værdipapirhandel), § 10

titles.en: Give a retail client a suitability statement before an advised transaction

summaries.en: Before a transaction the firm has advised a retail client on, it must give the client a statement on a durable medium describing the advice and how it matches the client's preferences, objectives and other characteristics. Where a distance contract prevents this, the statement may follow immediately after the client is bound, on the conditions the order sets.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Sell subordinated eligible liabilities to retail clients only after a documented suitability test
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 760 af 14/06/2024 (investorbeskyttelse ved værdipapirhandel), § 11

titles.en: Sell subordinated eligible liabilities to retail clients only after a documented suitability test

summaries.en: A credit institution may sell subordinated eligible liabilities, additional tier 1 and tier 2 instruments to a retail client only after a suitability test shows they are suitable and the suitability is documented. Where the client's portfolio is EUR 500,000 or less, the total holding of such instruments may not exceed 10 per cent of the portfolio and the initial amount must be at least EUR 10,000.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess appropriateness for non-advised retail orders and warn the client
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 760 af 14/06/2024 (investorbeskyttelse ved værdipapirhandel), §§ 12-13

titles.en: Assess appropriateness for non-advised retail orders and warn the client

summaries.en: When executing or passing on orders for a retail client without advice or portfolio management, the firm must ask about the client's knowledge and experience and assess whether the product or service is appropriate, and warn the client expressly if it is not or if the client's information is insufficient. Execution-only business in the non-complex instruments listed in § 13 can be exempt when its conditions are met.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report to clients on the services provided, including periodic suitability updates
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 760 af 14/06/2024 (investorbeskyttelse ved værdipapirhandel), §§ 15-16

titles.en: Report to clients on the services provided, including periodic suitability updates

summaries.en: The firm must report to clients on the services it has carried out, with periodic communications suited to the instruments and service and, where relevant, the costs incurred; professional clients get such reports only on written request, and the firm keeps a register of those requests. Periodic reports to retail clients under portfolio management, or under advice with a periodic suitability assessment, must include an updated suitability statement.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Review the investor protection procedures at least once a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 760 af 14/06/2024 (investorbeskyttelse ved værdipapirhandel), § 17

titles.en: Review the investor protection procedures at least once a year

summaries.en: At least once a year the firm must assess whether its procedures for complying with this order work as intended and remedy any deficiencies.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om god skik for finansielle virksomheder, BEK nr 330 af 07/04/2016
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 330 af 07/04/2016, signed for Erhvervs- og Vækstministeriet (today Erhvervsministeriet, under which Retsinformation lists it) by the minister (Troels Lund Poulsen), § 31 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om god skik for finansielle virksomheder
titles.en: Executive Order on good business practice for financial undertakings

payload.shortName: Bekendtgørelse om god skik for finansielle virksomheder
payload.implementsNote: Parts of the third non-life insurance directive, Directive 92/49/EEC, and of the Unfair Commercial Practices Directive, Directive 2005/29/EC

obligations.title: Add the duty: Deal honestly and loyally with customers and show good business practice towards consumers
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 330 af 07/04/2016 (god skik for finansielle virksomheder), §§ 3-4 and § 5 c, as amended by BEK nr 1159 af 18/09/2018 and BEK nr 1640 af 09/12/2024

titles.en: Deal honestly and loyally with customers and show good business practice towards consumers

summaries.en: A financial undertaking must act honestly and loyally towards its customers, and in its commercial practices towards consumers it must show good business practice. A breach of the consumer rule requires that the practice materially distorts, or is likely to distort, the economic behaviour of the average consumer or of the targeted group.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Conclude or confirm all material customer agreements on paper or another durable medium
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 330 af 07/04/2016 (god skik for finansielle virksomheder), § 6, stk. 1-2

titles.en: Conclude or confirm all material customer agreements on paper or another durable medium

summaries.en: All material agreements with customers must be concluded or confirmed on paper or another durable medium, describing the parties' main rights and duties and the services covered. Where individual advice was given when the agreement was made, the main assumptions of that advice must be written into the agreement or an annex.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give at least one month's reasoned notice of unfavourable changes to interest and fees
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 330 af 07/04/2016 (god skik for finansielle virksomheder), § 6, stk. 3-5, as amended by BEK nr 1159 af 18/09/2018

titles.en: Give at least one month's reasoned notice of unfavourable changes to interest and fees

summaries.en: Terms allowing changes to interest, fees or other charges must be highlighted, state what can trigger a change and not give arbitrary discretion. In ongoing relationships, changes to the customer's disadvantage need at least one month's notice with reasons, except changes caused by external factors; material fee changes and new fees must be notified individually before they take effect, and the firm's own termination must be objectively justified and given on paper or another durable medium.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Take special care in commercial practices and advice aimed at children and young people
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 330 af 07/04/2016 (god skik for finansielle virksomheder), § 7, as amended by BEK nr 1159 af 18/09/2018

titles.en: Take special care in commercial practices and advice aimed at children and young people

summaries.en: Commercial practices and advice directed at children and young people must be designed with particular regard to their lack of experience and critical sense, which makes them easy to influence.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Advise when asked or needed, in the customer's interest, and say the advice is not independent
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 330 af 07/04/2016 (god skik for finansielle virksomheder), § 8

titles.en: Advise when asked or needed, in the customer's interest, and say the advice is not independent

summaries.en: The firm must give advice when the customer asks and on its own initiative when the circumstances call for it. Advice must serve the customer's interests, be relevant, accurate and adequate, and cover the risks that matter to the customer; the firm must say that the advice is not independent and covers only its own products unless it can document independence, and must flag products offered with standardised information and little individual advice (not allowed for loans secured on real property).

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ask about the customer's situation before advising and keep it up to date
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 330 af 07/04/2016 (god skik for finansielle virksomheder), §§ 9-10

titles.en: Ask about the customer's situation before advising and keep it up to date

summaries.en: Before advising, the firm must ask the customer about their financial situation, experience with the relevant services, purpose and risk appetite, scaled to what the customer knows and what the firm already has. Advice is based on that information and the firm's other knowledge of the customer, and in ongoing relationships the firm asks for updates as needed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Inform about own products, price differences, the APR on loans and relevant product types
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 330 af 07/04/2016 (god skik for finansielle virksomheder), § 11

titles.en: Inform about own products, price differences, the APR on loans and relevant product types

summaries.en: The firm must give adequate information on its own products and services, including differences in price and terms between alternatives that could meet the customer's needs, and the annual percentage rate of charge (ÅOP) on loans at the time of advice. It must tell a customer before agreement if prices for a service are generally differentiated between customers, and inform about relevant product types on the market without naming competitors or prices.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Disclose special interests in the advice and commissions received
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 330 af 07/04/2016 (god skik for finansielle virksomheder), § 12

titles.en: Disclose special interests in the advice and commissions received

summaries.en: Before advising, the firm must tell the customer the nature and extent of any special interest that it or the adviser has in the outcome beyond ordinary earnings. The customer must also be told when the firm receives commission or other payment for passing on products, and when the adviser's pay is directly linked to specific sales.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Explain the relevant tax consequences of the products advised on
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 330 af 07/04/2016 (god skik for finansielle virksomheder), § 13, stk. 1-2 (stk. 3 repealed by BEK nr 1159 af 18/09/2018)

titles.en: Explain the relevant tax consequences of the products advised on

summaries.en: As part of its advice the firm must explain the tax rules relevant to the customer for the products and services advised on, and refer the customer elsewhere for other tax questions it notices but does not advise on.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell customers which security precautions to take and their liability for misuse
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 330 af 07/04/2016 (god skik for finansielle virksomheder), § 14

titles.en: Tell customers which security precautions to take and their liability for misuse

summaries.en: The firm must inform customers of the security precautions to observe for a product or service, including the security requirements the customer must meet and the liability the customer may incur if a third party misuses it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Offer private customers a basic deposit account and refuse only on objective individual grounds
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 330 af 07/04/2016 (god skik for finansielle virksomheder), § 15

titles.en: Offer private customers a basic deposit account and refuse only on objective individual grounds

summaries.en: A bank may refuse to open a basic deposit account for a private customer only on individual, objective grounds, given in writing on request. The account must at least allow cash deposits and withdrawals (counter service may be limited to once a week), payments by a balance-checked debit card (or a withdrawal card where the bank offers no such card) and incoming credit transfers, free or for a fee of at most DKK 180 a year, indexed each year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not tie loans or progressive benefits to owning the bank's own shares
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 330 af 07/04/2016 (god skik for finansielle virksomheder), § 16 and § 16 a, inserted by BEK nr 1592 af 17/12/2018

titles.en: Do not tie loans or progressive benefits to owning the bank's own shares

summaries.en: A bank may not link a progressive benefit programme to holding its shares, guarantee capital or cooperative capital; where such holdings are a condition for customer benefits, the requirement may not exceed a market value or deposit of DKK 30,000. A bank may not require a borrower to acquire ownership shares in the bank or a group company as a condition for a loan.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om outsourcing for kreditinstitutter, BEK nr 973 af 22/06/2022
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 973 af 22/06/2022, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Simon Kollerup), § 31 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om outsourcing for kreditinstitutter m.v.
titles.en: Executive Order on outsourcing for credit institutions etc.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the board own outsourcing and approve a written outsourcing policy
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 973 af 22/06/2022 (outsourcing for kreditinstitutter m.v.), § 10

titles.en: Have the board own outsourcing and approve a written outsourcing policy

summaries.en: The board is responsible for the safe use of outsourcing, cannot outsource its own responsibilities and must oversee executive management's decisions and all outsourcing risks. It must approve, regularly review and update a written outsourcing policy meeting Annex 1 and make sure the policy is followed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set the board's framework before entering critical or important outsourcing
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 973 af 22/06/2022 (outsourcing for kreditinstitutter m.v.), § 11

titles.en: Set the board's framework before entering critical or important outsourcing

summaries.en: Before critical or important outsourcing contracts are entered, the board must decide clear frameworks and conditions, including the risks it can accept, based on a prior analysis that at least covers criticality, conflicts of interest, licensing, risk assessment and provider due diligence.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint an outsourcing officer and place responsibility for all outsourcing
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 973 af 22/06/2022 (outsourcing for kreditinstitutter m.v.), § 12

titles.en: Appoint an outsourcing officer and place responsibility for all outsourcing

summaries.en: Within the board's framework, executive management must ensure outsourcing is used safely, place responsibility for managing, monitoring, controlling and documenting all outsourcing unambiguously, and appoint an outsourcing officer responsible for that.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess operational risk and examine the provider before outsourcing
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 973 af 22/06/2022 (outsourcing for kreditinstitutter m.v.), §§ 19-20

titles.en: Assess operational risk and examine the provider before outsourcing

summaries.en: Before deciding to outsource or sub-outsource, the firm must assess the potential effect on its operational risk, including classifying the processes, data and systems involved, and take measures to limit that risk. Before choosing a provider it must examine at least the provider's business model, size, complexity, financial situation, ownership, group links and supervision.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Put each outsourcing in a written contract with access and audit rights
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 973 af 22/06/2022 (outsourcing for kreditinstitutter m.v.), § 21

titles.en: Put each outsourcing in a written contract with access and audit rights

summaries.en: Every outsourcing needs a written contract that sets out the parties' rights and obligations clearly. Contracts for critical or important outsourcing must meet Annex 3, including access and audit rights for the firm, a third party it appoints and Finanstilsynet; for other outsourcing, Annex 3, point 3 applies and access and audit rights are set on a risk basis.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep an outsourcing register and documentation for at least five years
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 973 af 22/06/2022 (outsourcing for kreditinstitutter m.v.), § 16

titles.en: Keep an outsourcing register and documentation for at least five years

summaries.en: The firm must keep and continuously update a register of its outsourcing arrangements with the content in Annex 2, keep documentation of terminated outsourcing in the register and other documentation for at least five years, and give Finanstilsynet register extracts electronically on request without undue delay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep tested contingency plans and written exit strategies for critical outsourcing
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 973 af 22/06/2022 (outsourcing for kreditinstitutter m.v.), § 14 and § 17

titles.en: Keep tested contingency plans and written exit strategies for critical outsourcing

summaries.en: For critical or important outsourcing the firm must prepare, maintain and regularly test contingency plans and have written exit strategies meeting Annex 4; group-level plans can be used with the necessary adjustments.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Monitor and audit providers and act on deficiencies
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 973 af 22/06/2022 (outsourcing for kreditinstitutter m.v.), §§ 23-24

titles.en: Monitor and audit providers and act on deficiencies

summaries.en: On a risk basis the firm must continuously monitor, examine and control the provider's work and carry out audit reviews of the provider, and take appropriate measures, up to immediate termination, if it finds deficiencies in how the outsourced function is performed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify Finanstilsynet in good time of planned critical or important outsourcing
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 973 af 22/06/2022 (outsourcing for kreditinstitutter m.v.), § 28

titles.en: Notify Finanstilsynet in good time of planned critical or important outsourcing

summaries.en: The firm must notify Finanstilsynet in good time of planned critical or important outsourcing, with the information in Annex 2, point 1, and in good time of changes or events that could materially affect the continued delivery of existing outsourcing.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om lønpolitik og aflønning, BEK nr 1242 af 10/06/2021
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1242 af 10/06/2021, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Simon Kollerup), § 27 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om lønpolitik og aflønning i pengeinstitutter, realkreditinstitutter, fondsmæglerselskaber, investeringsforvaltningsselskaber, investeringsforeninger og visse holdingvirksomheder
titles.en: Executive Order on remuneration policy and remuneration in banks, mortgage-credit institutions, investment firms, investment management companies, investment associations and certain holding companies

payload.implementsNote: Parts of CRD, Directive 2013/36/EU, as amended by CRD V, Directive (EU) 2019/878, and parts of IFD, Directive (EU) 2019/2034

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify the staff whose activities materially affect the risk profile
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1242 af 10/06/2021 (lønpolitik og aflønning), § 2

titles.en: Identify the staff whose activities materially affect the risk profile

summaries.en: In a bank the board must identify material risk takers using the minimum categories in § 2(2), such as all board and executive members and heads of the control functions, and the delegated regulations adopted under CRD Article 94(2).

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the board set the remuneration policy and review it at least yearly
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1242 af 10/06/2021 (lønpolitik og aflønning), §§ 5-6

titles.en: Have the board set the remuneration policy and review it at least yearly

summaries.en: The board must set the firm's remuneration policy for board members and staff, proportionate to the firm's size, organisation and complexity, is responsible for implementing it, and must review it at least once a year to keep it in line with the firm's development.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Check compliance with the remuneration policy at least once a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1242 af 10/06/2021 (lønpolitik og aflønning), §§ 7-8

titles.en: Check compliance with the remuneration policy at least once a year

summaries.en: The board must ensure that compliance with the remuneration policy is checked at least once a year under guidelines it sets, with the result reported to it, and must oversee the pay of executive management and the heads of the risk, compliance and internal audit functions; a remuneration committee, if any, does this oversight. Staff who draft and control the policy must be competent and, proportionately, independent of the units they control.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make the remuneration policy support sound risk management
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1242 af 10/06/2021 (lønpolitik og aflønning), § 9

titles.en: Make the remuneration policy support sound risk management

summaries.en: The policy must be consistent with and promote sound and effective risk management, must not encourage excessive risk-taking, must fit the firm's strategy, values and long-term objectives, and must set the pension policy and guidelines for variable pay, severance pay and identifying other material risk takers.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Balance fixed and variable pay and base variable pay on risk-adjusted performance
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1242 af 10/06/2021 (lønpolitik og aflønning), §§ 10-11

titles.en: Balance fixed and variable pay and base variable pay on risk-adjusted performance

summaries.en: Where variable pay is granted to board members, executives or other material risk takers, the firm must keep an appropriate balance with fixed pay, including a cap within the limits of the Financial Business Act. Performance-based variable pay rests on the individual's, the unit's and the firm's results, measured with regard to current and future risks, capital and liquidity costs, and both financial and non-financial criteria.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep control-function pay independent of the results they control
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1242 af 10/06/2021 (lønpolitik og aflønning), § 13

titles.en: Keep control-function pay independent of the results they control

summaries.en: Where staff working in the control functions receive variable pay, it must not depend on the results of the unit they control.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report and publish the CRR Article 450 remuneration information by 1 May
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1242 af 10/06/2021 (lønpolitik og aflønning), § 20

titles.en: Report and publish the CRR Article 450 remuneration information by 1 May

summaries.en: Right after the financial year closes, and by 1 May each year, a bank must submit the remuneration information in CRR Article 450(1)(g) to (i) and (k) to Finanstilsynet electronically on its forms, and publish the same information on its website at the same time.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish on the website how the firm meets the remuneration requirements
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1242 af 10/06/2021 (lønpolitik og aflønning), § 22

titles.en: Publish on the website how the firm meets the remuneration requirements

summaries.en: A firm with a website must publish there how it complies with the order's requirements on setting, reviewing and controlling the policy, its content, performance-based pay, control-function pay and the treatment of severance, sign-on and buy-out pay, as far as they apply to it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the number of staff earning more than EUR 1 million a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1242 af 10/06/2021 (lønpolitik og aflønning), § 23

titles.en: Report the number of staff earning more than EUR 1 million a year

summaries.en: By 1 May each year the firm must report to Finanstilsynet the number of persons whose total pay including pension for the previous financial year exceeded the equivalent of EUR 1 million, in bands of EUR 1 million; a top EU parent also reports this for the group.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply the remuneration rules across subsidiaries in the group
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1242 af 10/06/2021 (lønpolitik og aflønning), § 24

titles.en: Apply the remuneration rules across subsidiaries in the group

summaries.en: A bank, mortgage-credit institution or financial holding company must ensure that its remuneration policy and the specific remuneration requirements are followed by its subsidiaries in the group; subsidiaries outside the order meet their own sector rules, and third-country rules can justify exceptions when Finanstilsynet is satisfied.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om klagehåndtering, BEK nr 1558 af 06/12/2024
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1558 af 06/12/2024, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Morten Bødskov), § 7 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om den klageansvarlige og finansielle virksomheders håndtering af klager
titles.en: Executive Order on the complaints officer and financial undertakings' handling of complaints

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have a complaint-handling procedure with acknowledgement within three working days
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1558 af 06/12/2024 (klageansvarlig og klagehåndtering), § 3

titles.en: Have a complaint-handling procedure with acknowledgement within three working days

summaries.en: The firm must have a written procedure for handling complaints that describes how complaints are handled and how customers are guided, ensures every complaint is treated objectively, acknowledges receipt within three working days and gets complaints dealt with within a reasonable time.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint a complaints officer responsible for handling complaints
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1558 af 06/12/2024 (klageansvarlig og klagehåndtering), § 4

titles.en: Appoint a complaints officer responsible for handling complaints

summaries.en: The firm must appoint a complaints officer, a person or unit responsible for complaint handling, who ensures that all complaints are handled under the firm's procedure.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish who the complaints officer is and how to contact them
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1558 af 06/12/2024 (klageansvarlig og klagehåndtering), § 5

titles.en: Publish who the complaints officer is and how to contact them

summaries.en: The firm must make it easy to find on its website who its complaints officer is and where and how to contact them (or give this on request if it has no website), and must guide customers about their right to complain to the complaints officer when circumstances call for it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Be able to see how many complaints the complaints officer receives
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1558 af 06/12/2024 (klageansvarlig og klagehåndtering), § 6

titles.en: Be able to see how many complaints the complaints officer receives

summaries.en: The firm must organise itself so that it can easily get an overview of how many complaints its complaints officer receives.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om god skik for boligkredit, BEK nr 1443 af 27/11/2025
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1443 af 27/11/2025, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Morten Bødskov), § 33 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om god skik for boligkredit
titles.en: Executive Order on good business practice for housing credit

payload.shortName: Bekendtgørelse om god skik for boligkredit
payload.implementsNote: Parts of MCD, Directive 2014/17/EU, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2016/1011, and parts of the Unfair Commercial Practices Directive, Directive 2005/29/EC

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act honestly, transparently and loyally and market housing credit fairly
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1443 af 27/11/2025 (god skik for boligkredit), §§ 3-5

titles.en: Act honestly, transparently and loyally and market housing credit fairly

summaries.en: A housing credit lender or intermediary must act honestly, transparently and loyally and in line with good business practice, and market housing credit agreements in a fair, clear and non-misleading way without wording that creates false expectations about availability or cost.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Put housing credit agreements in writing and give notice of unfavourable changes
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1443 af 27/11/2025 (god skik for boligkredit), §§ 8-9

titles.en: Put housing credit agreements in writing and give notice of unfavourable changes

summaries.en: Material agreements with borrowers must be made or confirmed on paper or another durable medium. Terms on changes to interest, fees or contributions must be highlighted and state their triggers; unfavourable interest changes need at least one month's reasoned notice and changes to fees, contributions or other charges at least three months', except for external factors, with individual notice for contribution changes and material fee changes.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish general housing credit information and include standard information in marketing
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1443 af 27/11/2025 (god skik for boligkredit), §§ 11-13

titles.en: Publish general housing credit information and include standard information in marketing

summaries.en: A lender or tied intermediary must keep clear, understandable general information about its housing credit agreements available at all times, free of charge. Any marketing that states an interest rate or cost figures must contain the standard information, including the APR on a representative example based on Annex 1.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Explain the proposed loan and state whether and on what basis advice is given
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1443 af 27/11/2025 (god skik for boligkredit), §§ 15-16

titles.en: Explain the proposed loan and state whether and on what basis advice is given

summaries.en: The lender must give the borrower adequate explanations of the proposed agreement and any ancillary services, including its main features and consequences such as the effect of default. Before the agreement it must say expressly whether advice is or can be given, and before advising it must state on a durable medium the product range the advice covers and any advice fee; when advising it gathers the borrower's personal and financial information to recommend suitable agreements.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess creditworthiness thoroughly and lend only where repayment is likely
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1443 af 27/11/2025 (god skik for boligkredit), §§ 17-18

titles.en: Assess creditworthiness thoroughly and lend only where repayment is likely

summaries.en: Before a housing credit agreement the lender must thoroughly assess the borrower's creditworthiness on necessary, sufficient and proportionate information about income, expenses and other financial circumstances, and may only grant the credit if the assessment makes it likely the borrower can meet the agreement.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Offer variable-rate or interest-only home loans only to borrowers who qualify for a 30-year fixed-rate loan
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1443 af 27/11/2025 (god skik for boligkredit), § 19

titles.en: Offer variable-rate or interest-only home loans only to borrowers who qualify for a 30-year fixed-rate loan

summaries.en: As a rule, variable-rate and interest-only loans secured on real property may only be offered to borrowers whose finances would qualify them for a 30-year fixed-rate loan with repayments, for the part within the mortgage lending limits. The lender must also ensure an appropriate down payment on home purchases and avoid risky high loan-to-value loans to consumers with a high debt factor; these rules do not apply to loans of DKK 100,000 or less.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Value the property with reliable standards, also when a third party values it
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1443 af 27/11/2025 (god skik for boligkredit), § 20

titles.en: Value the property with reliable standards, also when a third party values it

summaries.en: The lender must use reliable standards, being those in § 2 of BEK nr 807 of 31 May 2022, when valuing the residential property behind a housing credit agreement, and ensure the same standards are used when a third party values it on the lender's behalf.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the borrower at once of a refusal and of any database used
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1443 af 27/11/2025 (god skik for boligkredit), § 21

titles.en: Tell the borrower at once of a refusal and of any database used

summaries.en: If a credit application is refused, the lender must inform the borrower immediately and say whether the decision was based on automated processing; if so, it names the database consulted and the result of the search.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not tie housing credit to other products or to buying the lender's shares
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1443 af 27/11/2025 (god skik for boligkredit), §§ 28-29

titles.en: Do not tie housing credit to other products or to buying the lender's shares

summaries.en: A lender may sell products in packages but may not tie them, except for the payment, savings, investment or pension products the order allows or with Finanstilsynet's permission. It may not require the borrower to acquire ownership shares in the lender or a group company as a condition for the credit, save for cooperative capital in a cooperative bank within the order's limits.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om god skik for forsikringsdistributører, BEK nr 1557 af 06/12/2024
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1557 af 06/12/2024, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Morten Bødskov), § 43 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om god skik for forsikringsdistributører
titles.en: Executive Order on good business practice for insurance distributors

payload.shortName: Bekendtgørelse om god skik for forsikringsdistributører
payload.implementsNote: Parts of IDD, Directive (EU) 2016/97, and parts of the Unfair Commercial Practices Directive, Directive 2005/29/EC

obligations.title: Add the duty: Deal honestly and loyally and keep commercial information clear and not misleading
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1557 af 06/12/2024 (god skik for forsikringsdistributører), §§ 4-6, § 6 as replaced by BEK nr 1637 af 09/12/2024

titles.en: Deal honestly and loyally and keep commercial information clear and not misleading

summaries.en: An insurance distributor must act honestly and loyally towards customers and show good business practice towards consumers. Information given as part of its commercial practice must be fair, clear and not misleading, and marketing material must be clearly identifiable as marketing.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the customer the intermediary's pre-contract information in good time
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1557 af 06/12/2024 (god skik for forsikringsdistributører), § 14

titles.en: Give the customer the intermediary's pre-contract information in good time

summaries.en: In good time before an insurance contract is concluded, an insurance intermediary must tell the customer its name and address and that it is an intermediary, whether it advises, how to complain, the register it is in, whom it acts for, any holdings of 10 per cent or more to or from an insurer, the basis of its advice or its contractual ties to insurers, and the type of remuneration it receives.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give relevant, understandable product information before the contract
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1557 af 06/12/2024 (god skik for forsikringsdistributører), § 16

titles.en: Give relevant, understandable product information before the contract

summaries.en: Whether or not advice is given and whether or not the product is part of a package, the distributor must give the customer the relevant information about the insurance product before the contract, in a form adapted to the product's complexity and the type of customer, so the customer can make an informed decision.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Establish the customer's demands and needs and propose only consistent contracts
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1557 af 06/12/2024 (god skik for forsikringsdistributører), § 20

titles.en: Establish the customer's demands and needs and propose only consistent contracts

summaries.en: Before a contract is concluded the distributor must establish the customer's demands and needs from the customer's information, give objective product information in an understandable way, and propose only contracts consistent with those demands and needs, also for each insurance in a package.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give a personal recommendation explaining why the product best meets the customer's needs
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1557 af 06/12/2024 (god skik for forsikringsdistributører), § 21

titles.en: Give a personal recommendation explaining why the product best meets the customer's needs

summaries.en: Where the distributor advises before a contract, it must give an individual recommendation explaining why a particular product best meets the customer's insurance demands and needs.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Say whether bundled components can be bought separately and show their costs
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1557 af 06/12/2024 (god skik for forsikringsdistributører), § 23

titles.en: Say whether bundled components can be bought separately and show their costs

summaries.en: When insurance is offered together with a non-insurance product or service as a package, the distributor must tell the customer whether the parts can be bought separately and, if so, describe them and document the costs and charges of each, and explain how the package changes the cover or risk where it does.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Accept or pay inducements on insurance-based investment products only if they do not harm the client
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1557 af 06/12/2024 (god skik for forsikringsdistributører), § 36

titles.en: Accept or pay inducements on insurance-based investment products only if they do not harm the client

summaries.en: Fees, commissions or non-monetary benefits paid to or received from others in connection with insurance-based investment products are allowed only where they do not harm the quality of the service and do not impair the duty to act honestly, fairly and professionally in the customer's best interest.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess suitability or appropriateness for insurance-based investment products
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1557 af 06/12/2024 (god skik for forsikringsdistributører), §§ 37-38

titles.en: Assess suitability or appropriateness for insurance-based investment products

summaries.en: When advising on an insurance-based investment product the distributor must obtain the customer's knowledge and experience, financial situation including ability to bear losses, investment objectives and risk tolerance and recommend only suitable products, assessing a package as a whole. Without advice it must ask about knowledge and experience and assess whether the product is appropriate.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om kompetencekrav ved investeringsrådgivning, BEK nr 1037 af 15/06/2022
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1037 af 15/06/2022, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Simon Kollerup), § 15 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om kompetencekrav til ansatte, der yder investeringsrådgivning og formidler information om visse investeringsprodukter
titles.en: Executive Order on competence requirements for employees who give investment advice and provide information on certain investment products

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ensure staff advising retail clients on investments are competent and experienced
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1037 af 15/06/2022 (kompetencekrav, investeringsrådgivning), § 3

titles.en: Ensure staff advising retail clients on investments are competent and experienced

summaries.en: The firm must ensure that staff who give investment advice or advice on pools, or provide information about investment products to retail clients, can do so soundly: six months' documented full-time experience and the competences in Annex 1 (advice) or Annex 2 (information). It assesses at least once a year whether each employee meets the requirements; staff without them may work under supervision of a qualified colleague for at most four years.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have a systematic training programme completed before staff start advising or informing
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1037 af 15/06/2022 (kompetencekrav, investeringsrådgivning), §§ 4-5

titles.en: Have a systematic training programme completed before staff start advising or informing

summaries.en: The firm must have a procedure for a systematic training programme that gives staff the required competences, and ensure staff have completed it before they begin advising on non-complex products or pools, or providing information about investment products.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have advisers on complex products pass an approved exam and re-pass it every three years
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1037 af 15/06/2022 (kompetencekrav, investeringsrådgivning), § 7

titles.en: Have advisers on complex products pass an approved exam and re-pass it every three years

summaries.en: Staff who advise on products other than the non-complex products listed in the investor protection order must pass an exam from a provider approved by Finanstilsynet before they start advising, and pass a new exam every three years.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om kompetencekrav ved boligkredit, BEK nr 1425 af 27/11/2025
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1425 af 27/11/2025, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Morten Bødskov), § 7 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om kompetencekrav til boligkreditgivere og boligkreditformidlere
titles.en: Executive Order on competence requirements for housing credit lenders and housing credit intermediaries

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ensure staff advising on or granting housing credit have the required knowledge
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1425 af 27/11/2025 (kompetencekrav, boligkredit), §§ 3-4

titles.en: Ensure staff advising on or granting housing credit have the required knowledge

summaries.en: A lender must have staff who together have sufficient competence to advise on, design, offer and grant housing credit agreements and any ancillary services, and each employee who advises on or intermediates such credit must know the areas listed in § 4, such as products, consumer credit law, property purchase and valuation, land registration, creditworthiness assessment and relevant tax rules.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have a systematic training programme completed before staff work with housing credit
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1425 af 27/11/2025 (kompetencekrav, boligkredit), §§ 5-6

titles.en: Have a systematic training programme completed before staff work with housing credit

summaries.en: The lender must have a procedure for systematic training and ensure staff have completed it before they grant, intermediate or advise on housing credit; competence can come from a relevant theoretical course or at least two years' relevant employment. The lender also ensures the staff of a tied intermediary acting for it meet the same requirements.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om afviklingsplanlægning, BEK nr 2018 af 26/10/2021
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 2018 af 26/10/2021, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Simon Kollerup), § 15 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om afviklingsplanlægning og afviklingsberedskab
titles.en: Executive Order on resolution planning and resolution preparedness

payload.implementsNote: Parts of BRRD, Directive 2014/59/EU, as amended by BRRD II, Directive (EU) 2019/879

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit the information Finanstilsynet requests for resolution planning
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 2018 af 26/10/2021 (afviklingsplanlægning og afviklingsberedskab), § 3

titles.en: Submit the information Finanstilsynet requests for resolution planning

summaries.en: On Finanstilsynet's request and within its deadline, the firm must submit the overviews and information in Annex 1 that Finanstilsynet needs to draw up, adopt and maintain a resolution plan or group resolution plan, where they are not already available in a usable format.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Be able to produce a resolution balance sheet and specified liabilities and deposits
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 2018 af 26/10/2021 (afviklingsplanlægning og afviklingsberedskab), §§ 4-6

titles.en: Be able to produce a resolution balance sheet and specified liabilities and deposits

summaries.en: For Finansiel Stabilitet's restructuring or resolution of the firm, it must be able to produce a balance sheet meeting Annex 2, a specified statement of its liabilities meeting Annex 3 and a specified statement of eligible and covered deposits split by the types of deposit the guarantee scheme covers.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have systems to inform customers and creditors in a resolution
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 2018 af 26/10/2021 (afviklingsplanlægning og afviklingsberedskab), § 8

titles.en: Have systems to inform customers and creditors in a resolution

summaries.en: The firm must have a system for informing customers, creditors and others generally, and a system for informing them individually, when resolution measures are taken, including a transfer of all or part of its business.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have a system that can write down uncovered deposits on request
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 2018 af 26/10/2021 (afviklingsplanlægning og afviklingsberedskab), § 9

titles.en: Have a system that can write down uncovered deposits on request

summaries.en: The firm must have a system that, at Finansiel Stabilitet's request, can write down deposits above the guarantee scheme's cover temporarily and finally, in whole or in part.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep valuation information current and know the critical contracts
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 2018 af 26/10/2021 (afviklingsplanlægning og afviklingsberedskab), §§ 10-11

titles.en: Keep valuation information current and know the critical contracts

summaries.en: The firm must have effective governance that keeps the information in Annex 4 needed for valuations and resolution up to date and deliverable quickly on request, keep an overview of the scope, importance and location of its critical or important contracts, and have up-to-date methods to estimate the special costs and obligations a bankruptcy would trigger.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a register of financial contracts where the resolution plan requires it
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 2018 af 26/10/2021 (afviklingsplanlægning og afviklingsberedskab), § 12

titles.en: Keep a register of financial contracts where the resolution plan requires it

summaries.en: The firm must keep a register of financial contracts with the information set out in Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/1712, where its resolution plan or group resolution plan says so.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the auditor review resolution preparedness every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 2018 af 26/10/2021 (afviklingsplanlægning og afviklingsberedskab), § 13

titles.en: Have the auditor review resolution preparedness every year

summaries.en: Once a year the firm's external or internal auditor must review its procedures and systems for meeting §§ 4-12 and check, including by sampling, that the statements required by § 6 and Annex 3 can be produced at any time; the external auditor gives a statement on this in the form Finanstilsynet publishes.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om indskyder- og investorgarantiordningen, BEK nr 1483 af 02/12/2016
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1483 af 02/12/2016, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Brian Mikkelsen), § 27 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om en indskyder- og investorgarantiordning
titles.en: Executive Order on a depositor and investor guarantee scheme

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report covered deposits and risk data to Finansiel Stabilitet by 31 January
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1483 af 02/12/2016 (indskyder- og investorgarantiordning), § 7, stk. 4 and 6, and § 10, stk. 1

titles.en: Report covered deposits and risk data to Finansiel Stabilitet by 31 January

summaries.en: By 31 January each year a bank must report the Annex 2 information, including covered deposits and the risk indicators used for its contribution, to Finansiel Stabilitet, have its auditor confirm by 15 March that the reports are accurate, and send any updates or corrections without undue delay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay the annual contribution to the guarantee fund by 1 May
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1483 af 02/12/2016 (indskyder- og investorgarantiordning), § 5 and § 7

titles.en: Pay the annual contribution to the guarantee fund by 1 May

summaries.en: A bank must contribute to Garantiformuen from the year after it is licensed, based on its covered deposits and risk profile. Finansiel Stabilitet notifies the annual contribution by 15 April and the bank must pay it by 1 May; extraordinary contributions can also be levied.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om tredjepartsbetalinger, BEK nr 679 af 24/07/2026
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 679 af 24/07/2026, signed for Skatte- og Vækstministeriet by the minister (Jakob Engel-Schmidt), § 22 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om tredjepartsbetalinger m.v.
titles.en: Executive Order on third-party payments etc.

payload.implementsNote: Parts of MiFID II, Directive 2014/65/EU, Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2017/593, Directive (EU) 2021/338 and Directive (EU) 2024/2811

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pass on third-party payments received in portfolio management or independent advice
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 679 af 24/07/2026 (tredjepartsbetalinger m.v.), §§ 3-4

titles.en: Pass on third-party payments received in portfolio management or independent advice

summaries.en: A firm giving discretionary portfolio management or independent investment advice must pass on to the client, as soon as possible, any fees, commissions or monetary or non-monetary benefits received from third parties for that service, except acceptable minor non-monetary benefits, have procedures for this and inform the client periodically. It may pay third parties only on the conditions in § 4.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay or receive inducements in other services only when they enhance quality
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 679 af 24/07/2026 (tredjepartsbetalinger m.v.), §§ 6-7

titles.en: Pay or receive inducements in other services only when they enhance quality

summaries.en: For other investment and ancillary services, the firm may pay or receive third-party fees, commissions or non-monetary benefits only if they are designed to enhance the quality of the service to the client as § 7 defines it, do not impair its duty to act in the client's best interest and are disclosed beforehand.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a list of inducements and record how each enhances quality
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 679 af 24/07/2026 (tredjepartsbetalinger m.v.), § 8

titles.en: Keep a list of inducements and record how each enhances quality

summaries.en: The firm must document that the quality conditions are met by keeping an internal list of fees, commissions and non-monetary benefits paid to or received from third parties, and recording how they improve the service and what it does to keep acting in the client's best interest.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Disclose inducements before the service and their exact amount at least yearly
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 679 af 24/07/2026 (tredjepartsbetalinger m.v.), § 9

titles.en: Disclose inducements before the service and their exact amount at least yearly

summaries.en: Before providing the service the firm must tell the client about third-party payments and benefits, pricing non-minor benefits separately or explaining the calculation method where the amount is not yet known, and afterwards give the exact amount. As long as ongoing inducements are received it must tell the client the exact amount at least once a year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay for third-party research directly or from a controlled research payment account
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 679 af 24/07/2026 (tredjepartsbetalinger m.v.), §§ 11-13

titles.en: Pay for third-party research directly or from a controlled research payment account

summaries.en: Research received from third parties is not an inducement only if the firm pays for it from its own resources or from a separate research payment account it controls, funded by an agreed research charge, managed against a regularly assessed budget with quality criteria, and with increases in the budget explained to clients.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om prisinformation i pengeinstitutter, BEK nr 147 af 25/02/2020
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 147 af 25/02/2020, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Simon Kollerup), § 10 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om information til forbrugere om priser m.v. i pengeinstitutter
titles.en: Executive Order on information to consumers about prices etc. in banks

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish own fees and banknote exchange rates on the website
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 147 af 25/02/2020 (information til forbrugere om priser i pengeinstitutter), §§ 2-3, and BEK nr 1601 af 11/12/2025, § 1, nr. 1

titles.en: Publish own fees and banknote exchange rates on the website

summaries.en: A bank offering products to consumers must state clearly on its website the fees it sets and charges itself and, for the foreign banknotes it most commonly trades, its buying rate, selling rate and handling fee. From 20 November 2026 the order covers only deposit products, currency exchange and housing credit agreements.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish the rate, conditions and costs of the most common deposit accounts
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 147 af 25/02/2020 (information til forbrugere om priser i pengeinstitutter), §§ 4-5

titles.en: Publish the rate, conditions and costs of the most common deposit accounts

summaries.en: For deposit accounts held by at least 5 per cent of the target group, the bank must publish the nominal annual rate including compound interest, how the rate is set where it varies with the balance, special benefits and limits, and set-up and running costs; marketing that mentions a rate or cost figure must show this information clearly and prominently.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish standard information on the most common credit agreements
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 147 af 25/02/2020 (information til forbrugere om priser i pengeinstitutter), §§ 6-7, and BEK nr 1601 af 11/12/2025, § 1

titles.en: Publish standard information on the most common credit agreements

summaries.en: For credit agreements held by at least 5 per cent of the target group, the bank must publish standard information including the borrowing rate, total amount, APR, term and total amount payable, with highest and lowest figures where it uses a rate range, calculated on the Annex 1 assumptions; credit marketing with rate or cost figures must give it in a representative example. From 20 November 2026 this applies to housing credit agreements only and the marketing rule in § 7 is repealed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Disclose discounts given to members of associations or other groups
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 147 af 25/02/2020 (information til forbrugere om priser i pengeinstitutter), § 8

titles.en: Disclose discounts given to members of associations or other groups

summaries.en: Where the bank gives discounts or other special benefits to members of associations, organisations or other groups, such as employees of certain companies, it must say clearly on its website that it does so; discounts given within an employment relationship are exempt.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om CRS-indberetning, BEK nr 1160 af 09/09/2025
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1160 af 09/09/2025, signed for Skatteministeriet by the Minister for Taxation (Rasmus Stoklund); Retsinformation lists it under Skatte- og Vækstministeriet, § 123 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om identifikation og indberetning af finansielle konti med tilknytning til udlandet
titles.en: Executive Order on the identification and reporting of financial accounts with links to other countries

payload.implementsNote: DAC2, Directive 2014/107/EU, and DAC8, Directive (EU) 2023/2226, amending Directive 2011/16/EU

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register with the tax administration within eight days of becoming a reporting institution
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1160 af 09/09/2025 (finansielle konti med tilknytning til udlandet), § 62

titles.en: Register with the tax administration within eight days of becoming a reporting institution

summaries.en: A reporting financial institution must notify Skatteforvaltningen within eight days of becoming one, electronically or on its form; doubt about whether the duty applies does not exempt it from notifying.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain a self-certification of tax residence when opening an individual account
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1160 af 09/09/2025 (finansielle konti med tilknytning til udlandet), §§ 87-89

titles.en: Obtain a self-certification of tax residence when opening an individual account

summaries.en: When a new individual account is opened, the institution must obtain a self-certification that establishes the holder's tax residence or residences, confirm its reasonableness against the account-opening and AML/KYC information, and for residents of a participating jurisdiction record the tax identification number and date of birth. On a change of circumstances that makes it unreliable, a new valid self-certification is needed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Review pre-existing accounts for foreign indicia under the due diligence rules
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1160 af 09/09/2025 (finansielle konti med tilknytning til udlandet), §§ 69-75 and §§ 90-95

titles.en: Review pre-existing accounts for foreign indicia under the due diligence rules

summaries.en: For pre-existing individual accounts the institution relies on a documented residence address or searches its electronically searchable data for foreign indicia, and for pre-existing entity accounts above the DKK 1.5 million threshold it determines whether the holder or its controlling persons are reportable.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Determine the residence and controlling persons of new entity account holders
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1160 af 09/09/2025 (finansielle konti med tilknytning til udlandet), §§ 99-102

titles.en: Determine the residence and controlling persons of new entity account holders

summaries.en: For new entity accounts the institution must obtain a self-certification to determine the entity's residence and, where the holder is a passive non-financial entity, identify its controlling persons and whether they are reportable; it may not rely on a self-certification or document it knows or has reason to know is incorrect.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report reportable accounts to the tax administration by 1 May
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1160 af 09/09/2025 (finansielle konti med tilknytning til udlandet), § 111 and § 117; Annex 1 as replaced by BEK nr 717 af 28/08/2026

titles.en: Report reportable accounts to the tax administration by 1 May

summaries.en: For each reportable account the institution must report the information in § 111, such as identity, residence, tax identification numbers, account number, balance or value and income, to Skatteforvaltningen by 1 May of the year after the calendar year concerned; using service providers does not move the responsibility. The list of participating jurisdictions in Annex 1 was replaced from 1 September 2026.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om FATCA-indberetning, BEK nr 724 af 22/04/2021
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 724 af 22/04/2021, signed for Skatteministeriet by the Minister for Taxation (Morten Bødskov); Retsinformation lists it under Skatte- og Vækstministeriet, § 74 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om identifikation og indberetning af finansielle konti med tilknytning til USA
titles.en: Executive Order on the identification and reporting of financial accounts with links to the USA

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register as a FATCA reporting institution with the tax administration within eight days
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 724 af 22/04/2021 (finansielle konti med tilknytning til USA), § 29

titles.en: Register as a FATCA reporting institution with the tax administration within eight days

summaries.en: A reporting financial institution must notify Skatteforvaltningen within eight days of the reporting duty arising; this does not replace registration with the US authorities under US rules.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain a US tax self-certification when opening an individual account
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 724 af 22/04/2021 (finansielle konti med tilknytning til USA), §§ 44-47

titles.en: Obtain a US tax self-certification when opening an individual account

summaries.en: For new individual accounts not exempted by the USD 50,000 thresholds, the institution must obtain a self-certification at opening that shows whether the holder is US tax resident (US citizens included), confirm it against the opening and KYC information, and obtain the US taxpayer identification number where the holder is; if a change of circumstances makes it unreliable and no valid self-certification is obtained, the account is treated as reportable.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Classify entity account holders and identify US controlling persons of passive entities
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 724 af 22/04/2021 (finansielle konti med tilknytning til USA), §§ 53 and 55-57

titles.en: Classify entity account holders and identify US controlling persons of passive entities

summaries.en: The institution must determine which FATCA category an entity account holder belongs to, treat accounts of specified US persons as reportable, and for passive non-financial foreign entities identify the controlling persons under the customer identification procedures and whether any is a US citizen or resident.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report US reportable accounts to the tax administration by 1 May
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 724 af 22/04/2021 (finansielle konti med tilknytning til USA), §§ 66-67 and 69

titles.en: Report US reportable accounts to the tax administration by 1 May

summaries.en: Each year the institution must report for every US reportable account the holder's name, address, Danish and US tax numbers, account number, the institution's GIIN, the balance or value and the income paid, to Skatteforvaltningen by 1 May of the following year, having obtained the US taxpayer identification number for pre-existing reportable accounts.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om nedskrivningsegnede passiver (MREL), BEK nr 913 af 26/06/2025
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 913 af 26/06/2025, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Morten Bødskov), § 20 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om krav til nedskrivningsegnede passiver
titles.en: Executive Order on requirements for eligible liabilities

payload.implementsNote: Parts of BRRD II, Directive (EU) 2019/879, IFD, Directive (EU) 2019/2034, and Directive (EU) 2024/1174

obligations.title: Add the duty: Meet the requirement for eligible liabilities that Finanstilsynet sets
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 913 af 26/06/2025 (krav til nedskrivningsegnede passiver), §§ 3, 5, 9 and 13

titles.en: Meet the requirement for eligible liabilities that Finanstilsynet sets

summaries.en: A bank must hold eligible liabilities that meet the requirement Finanstilsynet sets after consulting Finansiel Stabilitet, sized so losses can be absorbed and the bank recapitalised, and expressed both as a percentage of its total risk exposure and of its leverage exposure, calculated under Annex 1 for resolution entities and for other entities. A parent that is not a resolution entity but is owned from a non-EU country meets it on a consolidated basis.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om den centrale kontomekanisme, BEK nr 1114 af 25/08/2023
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1114 af 25/08/2023, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Morten Bødskov), § 7 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om en central automatisk mekanisme for oplysninger om betalingskonti, bankkonti og deponeringsbokse
titles.en: Executive Order on a central automated mechanism for information on payment accounts, bank accounts and safe-deposit boxes

payload.implementsNote: Parts of AMLD5, Directive (EU) 2018/843, and DAC7, Directive (EU) 2021/514

obligations.title: Add the duty: Take part in the joint central mechanism identifying holders of accounts and safe-deposit boxes
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1114 af 25/08/2023 (central automatisk mekanisme for kontooplysninger), § 2

titles.en: Take part in the joint central mechanism identifying holders of accounts and safe-deposit boxes

summaries.en: Providers of IBAN payment or bank accounts and of safe-deposit boxes in Denmark must jointly set up one central automated mechanism that can identify everyone who holds or controls such accounts or boxes, appoint an operator as their data processor, and are each controllers for the personal data they put in.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Answer queries from the FIU and the tax administration through the mechanism within three bank days
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1114 af 25/08/2023 (central automatisk mekanisme for kontooplysninger), § 3

titles.en: Answer queries from the FIU and the tax administration through the mechanism within three bank days

summaries.en: When the Money Laundering Secretariat or Skatteforvaltningen queries the mechanism, the provider must report at once and within three bank days (one bank day in urgent cases) the identity of the account holder, anyone acting for them and the beneficial owner, the account or IBAN number and the opening and closing dates, or the box tenant and rental period, and is responsible for the accuracy of what it reports.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om udførelse af ordrer, BEK nr 917 af 25/06/2017
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 917 af 25/06/2017, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Brian Mikkelsen), § 13 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om værdipapirhandleres udførelse af ordrer
titles.en: Executive Order on securities dealers' execution of orders

payload.implementsNote: Parts of MiFID II, Directive 2014/65/EU, as amended by Directive (EU) 2024/790

obligations.title: Add the duty: Take all sufficient steps to get the best possible result when executing client orders
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 917 af 25/06/2017 (værdipapirhandleres udførelse af ordrer), § 3

titles.en: Take all sufficient steps to get the best possible result when executing client orders

summaries.en: When executing orders the firm must take all sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result for clients, considering price, costs, speed, likelihood of execution and settlement, size, nature and other relevant factors. For a retail client the best result is the lowest total consideration, meaning the price plus all execution-related costs, unless the purpose of the order makes other factors more relevant.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have an order execution policy, explain it and get the client's prior consent
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 917 af 25/06/2017 (værdipapirhandleres udførelse af ordrer), §§ 4-6

titles.en: Have an order execution policy, explain it and get the client's prior consent

summaries.en: The firm must have and apply an order execution policy naming, for each class of instrument, the venues it uses and the factors behind the choice, explain clearly to clients how it executes their orders, get their prior consent to the policy and, before executing outside a regulated market, MTF or OTF, their consent in general or per transaction, and show on request that orders followed the policy.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Monitor the execution arrangements and tell clients of material changes
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 917 af 25/06/2017 (værdipapirhandleres udførelse af ordrer), § 7, as amended by BEK nr 1082 af 25/08/2025

titles.en: Monitor the execution arrangements and tell clients of material changes

summaries.en: The firm must check that its execution arrangements and policy work as intended, regularly assess whether its venues give clients the best possible result, remedy deficiencies and notify clients with an ongoing relationship of any material change to the policy.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Handle client orders fairly and promptly and publish unexecuted limit orders
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 917 af 25/06/2017 (værdipapirhandleres udførelse af ordrer), §§ 9-10

titles.en: Handle client orders fairly and promptly and publish unexecuted limit orders

summaries.en: The firm must have procedures that execute client orders fairly and promptly relative to other orders and its own trading interests, in the order received. A client limit order in shares admitted to trading that cannot be executed at once must be made public promptly, for example by passing it to a trading venue, unless the client instructs otherwise.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om flytning af betalingskonti, BEK nr 1761 af 01/09/2021
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1761 af 01/09/2021, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Simon Kollerup), § 9 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om flytning af betalingskonti eller betalingsordrer
titles.en: Executive Order on switching payment accounts or payment orders

obligations.title: Add the duty: Offer and carry out payment account switching within the set deadlines
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1761 af 01/09/2021 (flytning af betalingskonti eller betalingsordrer), §§ 3-6

titles.en: Offer and carry out payment account switching within the set deadlines

summaries.en: A provider of consumer payment accounts must offer switching of accounts or payment orders to providers in Denmark in the same currency. The receiving provider starts the switch with the consumer's written consent and asks the transferring provider within two working days; the transferring provider sends the list of standing orders and direct debits within five working days and stops and cancels them from the agreed date, and the receiving provider sets them up within five working days of the list.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep switching fees cost-based and give switching information free
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1761 af 01/09/2021 (flytning af betalingskonti eller betalingsordrer), § 7

titles.en: Keep switching fees cost-based and give switching information free

summaries.en: Any fee for switching must be reasonable relative to the costs; consumers get information on their standing orders and direct debits free, the transferring provider may not charge for the list it sends, and closing fees must respect the Payments Act.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Advise the consumer before switching and publish the switching information
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1761 af 01/09/2021 (flytning af betalingskonti eller betalingsordrer), § 8

titles.en: Advise the consumer before switching and publish the switching information
