summaries.en: Before starting a switch the receiving provider must advise the consumer on each provider's tasks, the time each step takes, any fees, the information the consumer may need to give and the right to complain to a complaints board, and make this information available free on paper or another durable medium in its branches and on its website.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om gebyroplysningsdokument og gebyropgørelse, BEK nr 1609 af 18/12/2018
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1609 af 18/12/2018, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Rasmus Jarlov), § 6 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om repræsentative tjenesteydelser, gebyroplysningsdokument og gebyropgørelse
titles.en: Executive Order on representative services, the fee information document and the statement of fees

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use the standard terms and format in the fee information document and statement of fees
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1609 af 18/12/2018 (repræsentative tjenesteydelser, gebyroplysningsdokument og gebyropgørelse), §§ 3-5

titles.en: Use the standard terms and format in the fee information document and statement of fees

summaries.en: When describing payment account services in the fee information document, the statement of fees, contract information and marketing, the provider must use the standard terms and definitions in Annex 1. Both documents must be clear and readable, accurate and not misleading, in the account currency and the official language unless agreed otherwise, and carry their prescribed title and common symbol.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om sund virksomhedskultur, BEK nr 691 af 25/05/2020
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 691 af 25/05/2020, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Simon Kollerup), § 11 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om politik for sund virksomhedskultur i pengeinstitutter m.fl.
titles.en: Executive Order on a policy for a sound corporate culture in banks etc.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Adopt a written policy that secures a sound corporate culture
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 691 af 25/05/2020 (politik for sund virksomhedskultur), §§ 2-3

titles.en: Adopt a written policy that secures a sound corporate culture

summaries.en: The firm must have a written policy setting the overall framework for a sound culture throughout the organisation, with ethical and professional standards that foster honesty and integrity, based on its business model and reflecting its risks of breaching financial and AML law and of being used for money laundering. It must set principles for risk awareness, examples of acceptable and unacceptable conduct and how compliance with the policy is checked.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the board set the culture policy, assess it yearly and report on it
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 691 af 25/05/2020 (politik for sund virksomhedskultur), §§ 4-6

titles.en: Have the board set the culture policy, assess it yearly and report on it

summaries.en: The board sets the policy with enough knowledge of the firm, aligns it with other policies including remuneration, assesses at least once a year whether it is adequate, and oversees and documents its implementation; the chair accounts for its implementation in the annual report to the firm's supreme body.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the chief executive implement the culture policy and report on it at least yearly
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 691 af 25/05/2020 (politik for sund virksomhedskultur), §§ 7-9

titles.en: Have the chief executive implement the culture policy and report on it at least yearly

summaries.en: The chief executive must ensure the policy is implemented in daily operations and followed by staff, that new staff are made aware of it, that its procedures are clear, documented and transparent, and must report to the board on implementation at agreed intervals, at least once a year.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om offentliggørelse af Finanstilsynets vurdering, BEK nr 1389 af 04/12/2024
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1389 af 04/12/2024, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Morten Bødskov), § 10 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om finansielle virksomheders m.v. pligt til at offentliggøre Finanstilsynets vurdering af virksomheden m.v.
titles.en: Executive Order on the duty of financial undertakings etc. to publish Finanstilsynet's assessment of the undertaking

payload.shortName: Bekendtgørelse om offentliggørelse af Finanstilsynets vurdering

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish Finanstilsynet's statement on the firm within three working days
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1389 af 04/12/2024 (pligt til at offentliggøre Finanstilsynets vurdering), §§ 2-4

titles.en: Publish Finanstilsynet's statement on the firm within three working days

summaries.en: After an inspection, or after an order, reprimand or risk notice that matters to customers, the firm must publish Finanstilsynet's statement on its website within three working days of receiving it, with a visible link on the front page clearly labelled as a statement from Finanstilsynet, and tell Finanstilsynet it has done so. Publication can be deferred only where Finanstilsynet finds it would cause disproportionate harm or harm an investigation.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om kapital til det individuelle solvenstillæg, BEK nr 2143 af 22/12/2020
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 2143 af 22/12/2020, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Simon Kollerup), § 3 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om kapital til opfyldelse af det individuelle solvenstillæg for pengeinstitutter og realkreditinstitutter
titles.en: Executive Order on capital to meet the individual solvency add-on for banks and mortgage-credit institutions

payload.shortName: Bekendtgørelse om kapital til det individuelle solvenstillæg

obligations.title: Add the duty: Cover the individual solvency add-on with at least 56.25 per cent CET1 and 75 per cent tier 1
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 2143 af 22/12/2020 (kapital til det individuelle solvenstillæg), § 2

titles.en: Cover the individual solvency add-on with at least 56.25 per cent CET1 and 75 per cent tier 1

summaries.en: Capital used to cover the individual solvency add-on under § 124(3) of the Financial Business Act must consist of at least 56.25 per cent common equity tier 1 and at least 75 per cent tier 1 capital; the rest may be CET1, additional tier 1 or tier 2. Finanstilsynet can require higher shares.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om systemisk buffer, BEK nr 441 af 25/04/2025
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 441 af 25/04/2025, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Morten Bødskov), § 7 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om opgørelse af systemisk buffer
titles.en: Executive Order on calculating the systemic risk buffer

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate the systemic risk buffer with the Annex 1 formula
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 441 af 25/04/2025 (opgørelse af systemisk buffer), § 2

titles.en: Calculate the systemic risk buffer with the Annex 1 formula

summaries.en: A bank must calculate its systemic risk buffer with the formula in Annex 1, applying the buffer rates the Minister sets to its total risk exposure amount and to the relevant subsets of exposures.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish the institution-specific systemic buffer rate on the website
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 441 af 25/04/2025 (opgørelse af systemisk buffer), § 5, stk. 2

titles.en: Publish the institution-specific systemic buffer rate on the website

summaries.en: From the date it must apply the buffer rates, a bank must publish on its website its institution-specific systemic buffer rate, calculated as its systemic buffer divided by its total risk exposure amount.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om væsentlighedsgrænse for restancer, BEK nr 922 af 05/09/2019
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 922 af 05/09/2019, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Simon Kollerup), § 3 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om væsentlighedsgrænse for gældsforpligtelser i restance
titles.en: Executive Order on the materiality threshold for credit obligations past due

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply the Danish materiality threshold when counting days past due
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 922 af 05/09/2019 (væsentlighedsgrænse for gældsforpligtelser i restance), § 2

titles.en: Apply the Danish materiality threshold when counting days past due

summaries.en: A bank applying the CRR default definition must count past-due exposures against a threshold with an absolute component of DKK 750 for retail and DKK 4,000 for non-retail exposures and a relative component of 1 per cent of its on-balance exposures to the obligor, excluding equity exposures; it had to apply the threshold by 31 December 2020 at the latest.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om storaktionærer, BEK nr 1172 af 31/10/2017
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1172 af 31/10/2017, signed for Erhvervsministeriet by the minister (Brian Mikkelsen), § 21 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om storaktionærer
titles.en: Executive Order on major shareholders

payload.implementsNote: Parts of the Transparency Directive, Directive 2004/109/EC, as amended by Directives 2010/73/EU and 2013/50/EU, and of Commission Directive 2007/14/EC

obligations.title: Add the duty: File major holding notifications digitally on Finanstilsynet's form with the required content
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1172 af 31/10/2017 (storaktionærer), §§ 14-16 and 19

titles.en: File major holding notifications digitally on Finanstilsynet's form with the required content

summaries.en: Notifications of major holdings under §§ 38-40 of the Capital Markets Act go to Finanstilsynet digitally with a digital signature on its standard form, and the same content to the issuer: the change in voting rights or capital and the resulting holding, the date the threshold was crossed, the identity of the holder and of anyone entitled to vote for it, and the chain of controlled undertakings; they are given in Danish or English.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om Garantiformuens dækning, BEK nr 820 af 03/07/2015
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 820 af 03/07/2015, signed for Erhvervs- og Vækstministeriet (today Erhvervsministeriet, under which Retsinformation lists it) by the minister (Troels Lund Poulsen), § 28 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om Garantiformuens dækning af indskydere og investorer
titles.en: Executive Order on the guarantee fund's cover of depositors and investors

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give depositors the deposit guarantee information sheet before opening an account
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 820 af 03/07/2015 (Garantiformuens dækning af indskydere og investorer), § 10

titles.en: Give depositors the deposit guarantee information sheet before opening an account

summaries.en: No later than when a depositor agrees to open an account, the bank must make available the information on the guarantee scheme in § 15 and the information sheet in Annex 2, have the depositor confirm receipt, give it in Danish or another agreed language, and not use it for advertising.

obligations.title: Add the duty: State at least yearly on account statements whether deposits are eligible
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 820 af 03/07/2015 (Garantiformuens dækning af indskydere og investorer), § 11

titles.en: State at least yearly on account statements whether deposits are eligible

summaries.en: At least once a year the account statement must tell the depositor whether the balance is an eligible deposit and refer to the information sheet; for an empty account the bank says whether a deposit would be eligible. The information may not be used for advertising.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Show in branches and online where to get information on the guarantee scheme
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 820 af 03/07/2015 (Garantiformuens dækning af indskydere og investorer), §§ 14-15

titles.en: Show in branches and online where to get information on the guarantee scheme

summaries.en: The bank must show clearly on signs in its customer premises, and on its website where it takes deposits or does investment business online, where depositors and investors can get written information on the guarantee scheme, covering at least which scheme applies, the scope and calculation of cover, special deposits, what is not covered and how payouts work.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Be able to send each depositor's position to the guarantee fund within 12 hours of failure
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 820 af 03/07/2015 (Garantiformuens dækning af indskydere og investorer), § 20, stk. 3, as replaced by BEK nr 518 af 17/05/2018, § 1, nr. 7

titles.en: Be able to send each depositor's position to the guarantee fund within 12 hours of failure

summaries.en: Within 12 hours of the start of reconstruction or a bankruptcy order, the bank or its estate must send the guarantee fund a statement of each depositor's and investor's total position with the institution, prepared under Annex 3, so the fund can send depositors their overview.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om skatteindberetning, BEK nr 1016 af 22/06/2023
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1016 af 22/06/2023, signed for Skatteministeriet by the Minister for Taxation (Jeppe Bruus); Retsinformation lists it under Skatte- og Vækstministeriet, § 55 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om skatteindberetning m.v.
titles.en: Executive Order on tax reporting etc.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register as a tax reporting entity within eight days
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1016 af 22/06/2023 (skatteindberetning m.v.), § 1

titles.en: Register as a tax reporting entity within eight days

summaries.en: A bank that has to report under the Tax Reporting Act or this order must notify Skatteforvaltningen within eight days of the duty arising, with its name, address, CVR or SE number, start date and the nature of its reporting duty; doubt about the duty does not exempt it from notifying.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report pension schemes held with the bank to the tax administration every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1016 af 22/06/2023 (skatteindberetning m.v.), §§ 22 and 25

titles.en: Report pension schemes held with the bank to the tax administration every year

summaries.en: A bank must report every year on the pension schemes it holds, for each scheme the account holder, account number and tax designation, whether it is part of employment, payments in, dispositions and distributions for the previous year, and, for schemes under § 53 A of the Pension Taxation Act, the owner, value at year end and return.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report securities in custody and their returns with the required minimum content
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1016 af 22/06/2023 (skatteindberetning m.v.), §§ 35-36, as amended by BEK nr 1724 af 12/12/2023

titles.en: Report securities in custody and their returns with the required minimum content

summaries.en: Reporting on securities held in custody covers Danish and foreign bonds, hybrid debt-like instruments, investment fund units and shares in investment companies and their returns, and must include at least the reporting entity, the owners, the custody account, each security's identity with ISIN, its type and whether it is traded on a regulated market or MTF, holdings at year end, interest and other returns, and the market value where listed.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om overførsel af aktiesparekonto, BEK nr 19 af 10/01/2024
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 19 af 10/01/2024, signed for Skatteministeriet by the Minister for Taxation (Jeppe Bruus); Retsinformation lists it under Skatte- og Vækstministeriet, § 2 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om overførsel af aktiesparekontoen til et andet institut
titles.en: Executive Order on transferring the share savings account to another institution

obligations.title: Add the duty: Delay year-end share savings account transfers until 23 February
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 19 af 10/01/2024 (overførsel af aktiesparekontoen), § 1

titles.en: Delay year-end share savings account transfers until 23 February

summaries.en: If a customer asks between 15 December and 22 February to move a share savings account (aktiesparekonto) to another institution, the transfer can take effect no earlier than 23 February.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om børneopsparingskonti, BEK nr 420 af 02/05/2018
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 420 af 02/05/2018, signed for Skatteministeriet by the Minister for Taxation (Karsten Lauritzen); Retsinformation lists it under Skatte- og Vækstministeriet, § 11 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om børneopsparingskonti og om selvpensioneringskonti oprettet før den 2. juni 1998
titles.en: Executive Order on children's savings accounts and on self-pension accounts opened before 2 June 1998

obligations.title: Add the duty: Open children's savings accounts only on the order's terms and agree a binding period
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 420 af 02/05/2018 (børneopsparingskonti og selvpensioneringskonti), §§ 1 and 3

titles.en: Open children's savings accounts only on the order's terms and agree a binding period

summaries.en: A children's savings account can be opened at the latest in the year the child turns 14, by a relative in the ascending line (step and foster relationships count). The bank and the creator agree the binding period at opening; during it the balance cannot be transferred to ownership or pledged, and on the holder's death the account ends and the balance goes to the person entitled under the estate.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Agree transfers and investment of a children's savings account only with its creator
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 420 af 02/05/2018 (børneopsparingskonti og selvpensioneringskonti), §§ 4 and 6

titles.en: Agree transfers and investment of a children's savings account only with its creator

summaries.en: Transfers of the balance to another bank or life insurer, and how it is placed (cash, separate custody account or pool), may be agreed only with the creator of the account or the person to whom that right has passed. Where more than one account exists for the same child, only the first has tax validity unless the creators agree to merge them.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om indberetning af grænseoverskridende ordninger (DAC6), BEK nr 1634 af 27/12/2019
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1634 af 27/12/2019, signed for Skatteministeriet by the Minister for Taxation (Morten Bødskov); Retsinformation lists it under Skatte- og Vækstministeriet, § 32 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om indberetning af grænseoverskridende ordninger
titles.en: Executive Order on reporting cross-border arrangements

payload.shortName: Bekendtgørelse om indberetning af grænseoverskridende ordninger (DAC6)
payload.implementsNote: DAC6, Directive (EU) 2018/822, as amended by Directive (EU) 2020/876, and parts of DAC8, Directive (EU) 2023/2226, amending Directive 2011/16/EU

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register with the tax administration within eight days of becoming a DAC6 reporter
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1634 af 27/12/2019 (indberetning af grænseoverskridende ordninger), § 29

titles.en: Register with the tax administration within eight days of becoming a DAC6 reporter

summaries.en: An intermediary or relevant taxpayer with a Danish reporting duty must notify Skatteforvaltningen within eight days of the duty arising; doubt about the duty does not exempt it from notifying.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report reportable cross-border arrangements within 30 days
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1634 af 27/12/2019 (indberetning af grænseoverskridende ordninger), §§ 22-23, as amended by BEK nr 1049 af 29/06/2020 and BEK nr 1156 af 09/09/2025

titles.en: Report reportable cross-border arrangements within 30 days

summaries.en: An intermediary that designs, markets, organises, makes available or manages a reportable cross-border arrangement must report what it knows, holds or controls of the § 22 information, such as the parties, the hallmarks met and a summary of the arrangement, to Skatteforvaltningen within 30 days of the day after it is made available, ready for implementation or first implemented, whichever is first; a supporting intermediary reports within 30 days of giving its help.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om etableringskonto og iværksætterkonto, BEK nr 430 af 27/05/2009
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 430 af 27/05/2009, signed for Skatteministeriet by the Minister for Taxation (Kristian Jensen); Retsinformation lists it under Skatte- og Vækstministeriet, § 8 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om indskud på etableringskonto og iværksætterkonto
titles.en: Executive Order on deposits on establishment accounts and entrepreneur accounts

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report deposits on and withdrawals from establishment and entrepreneur accounts by 1 June
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 430 af 27/05/2009 (indskud på etableringskonto og iværksætterkonto), §§ 1-2 and 4-5

titles.en: Report deposits on and withdrawals from establishment and entrepreneur accounts by 1 June

summaries.en: By 1 June after each deposit year, the bank must report electronically to the tax administration, per account holder, the deposits made (account number, CPR number, dates, amounts) and the withdrawals made, with the dates of qualifying acquisitions and expenses. Such deposits must be kept on separate accounts, with each deposit year clearly identifiable.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Check withdrawal forms, keep them five years and withhold tax where the tax administration says so
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 430 af 27/05/2009 (indskud på etableringskonto og iværksætterkonto), §§ 3 and 6

titles.en: Check withdrawal forms, keep them five years and withhold tax where the tax administration says so

summaries.en: On a withdrawal the bank must check that every field of the tax administration's form is filled in and keep the form for five years after the year of withdrawal. In the cases the Act names, it may pay out only after the tax administration's notice, must withhold the tax stated and pay it to the tax administration within ten banking days.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om pensionsafkastbeskatning (PAL), BEK nr 1138 af 22/10/2014
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1138 af 22/10/2014, signed for Skatteministeriet by the Minister for Taxation (Benny Engelbrecht); Retsinformation lists it under Skatte- og Vækstministeriet, § 32 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om visse regler i pensionsafkastbeskatningsloven
titles.en: Executive Order on certain rules in the Pension Return Taxation Act

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep separate accounts for securities pools behind pension accounts
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1138 af 22/10/2014 (visse regler i pensionsafkastbeskatningsloven), § 6

titles.en: Keep separate accounts for securities pools behind pension accounts

summaries.en: A bank must keep a separate set of accounts for each pool of securities whose return is credited to pension savings and instalment savings accounts, showing the securities held at year end with nominal and market value, and the postings through the year; bonds are named by ISIN code and the pool's financial year is the calendar year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate pension return tax per account designation for each saver
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1138 af 22/10/2014 (visse regler i pensionsafkastbeskatningsloven), §§ 8 and 10

titles.en: Calculate pension return tax per account designation for each saver

summaries.en: A bank calculates the taxable base and the pension return tax jointly for all of a saver's schemes under the same account designation, allocates the tax pro rata to the schemes, and applies unused negative tax from earlier years in the order the rules set.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Delay year-end transfers of pension schemes until 23 January
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1138 af 22/10/2014 (visse regler i pensionsafkastbeskatningsloven), § 2

titles.en: Delay year-end transfers of pension schemes until 23 January

summaries.en: If a saver asks between 15 December and 22 January to move a scheme between two banks or between a bank and a pension institution, the transfer can take effect no earlier than 23 January of the year after the income year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell each saver every year the pension return tax for the past year
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1138 af 22/10/2014 (visse regler i pensionsafkastbeskatningsloven), § 20

titles.en: Tell each saver every year the pension return tax for the past year

summaries.en: The institution must notify each taxpayer every year of the amount of pension return tax for the previous income year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the PAL statement audited and the auditor's statement filed by 1 May
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1138 af 22/10/2014 (visse regler i pensionsafkastbeskatningsloven), §§ 23-28, as replaced by BEK nr 522 af 24/05/2016

titles.en: Have the PAL statement audited and the auditor's statement filed by 1 May

summaries.en: The institution's final statement of pension return tax must be audited under the order's rules, with the institution giving the auditor the information and access needed; for banks the auditor's signed statement goes to the tax administration by 1 May of the year after the income year.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om beskatning af pensionsordninger, BEK nr 1370 af 21/12/2012
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1370 af 21/12/2012, signed for Skatteministeriet by the Minister for Taxation (Holger K. Nielsen); Retsinformation lists it under Skatte- og Vækstministeriet, § 44 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om beskatningen af pensionsordninger
titles.en: Executive Order on the taxation of pension schemes

obligations.title: Add the duty: Mark pension savings with their tax designation on agreements and statements
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1370 af 21/12/2012 (beskatningen af pensionsordninger), §§ 4-5

titles.en: Mark pension savings with their tax designation on agreements and statements

summaries.en: When opening or changing savings taxed under the Pension Taxation Act, a bank must state the scheme's tax form, using the prescribed designations such as rateopsparing i pensionsøjemed, opsparing i pensionsøjemed, aldersopsparing or børneopsparingskonto, in the agreement, passbooks, custody certificates and account statements, and state whether the scheme is part of an employment relationship. The designations may not be used for savings that do not qualify.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate, withhold and pay the pension levy and file the levy notice
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1370 af 21/12/2012 (beskatningen af pensionsordninger), § 22, as amended by BEK nr 2216 af 29/11/2021

titles.en: Calculate, withhold and pay the pension levy and file the levy notice

summaries.en: When a scheme becomes subject to the levy, the institution where it is held calculates and withholds it, valuing securities at the quoted price, and pays it to Skatteforvaltningen within three bank days of the payout (or within a month where no payout triggered it), filing an electronic levy notice at the same time that splits taxable and tax-free amounts; wholly tax-free payouts are also notified within three bank days.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the yearly declaration on the pension levy with an auditor's statement
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1370 af 21/12/2012 (beskatningen af pensionsordninger), § 40

titles.en: File the yearly declaration on the pension levy with an auditor's statement

summaries.en: Every year, together with its tax return and tax accounts, the institution must give Skatteforvaltningen declarations on how it calculated, withheld and settled the levy, with the auditor's statement that the schemes were audited under the order.
